title: Young Woman by Italian Ravioli Storefront, 1920s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor portrait of a young woman standing on a sidewalk before a dark wooden shop doorway and storefront window during the late 1920s. She is dressed in Roaring Twenties fashion, featuring a dropped-waist dress with tiered ruffled flounces, strap shoes, and a tightly curled bob hairstyle. The storefront window behind her displays painted signage reading in part 'VIRGIN...', 'ITALIAN & F...', 'MERCHA...', and 'RAVIOLIES', reflecting Italian-American community commerce and urban food culture of the era.
